The '''Imperial Command Center''' was the seat of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] power on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gaevril Daraada]] was the senior Imperial officer at the base.<ref name="OOAK" />
